深入看：细胞受体与多感觉整合: A closer look: cellular receptors and multisensory integration
味觉细胞顶端的微绒毛接近味孔，能接触唾液中的物质。不同味质采用不同的受体或离子通: Microvilli at the tops of taste cells approach the taste pore and contact substances in saliva. Different taste qualities involve different receptors or ion channels. Cellular responses are communicated through nerves and processed further in the brain. Green highlights indicate signaling; they do not imply that every taste cell has the same receptor.
嗅觉感受细胞位于鼻腔上部。后鼻嗅觉需要挥发性分子到达那里，再转成神经信号；不是香: Smell-sensing cells lie in the upper nasal cavity. Retronasal smell requires volatile molecules to reach that region and generate nerve signals; aroma does not enter the brain directly. Complex airflow, nerve relays and brain networks are omitted. Slow-motion stages do not give exact sensory timing. Smell, basic tastes, texture and temperature have no fixed contribution percentages.
